description: Phase C: strict dead-rule and exact-duplicate removal from HAND-WRITTEN CSS only (styles.css, aws-design.css, app-theme.css, bottom-tab-bar.css, filters.css, chat-reactions.css, *-page.css); never the generated deduped file. Depends on FEAT-001 (coverage.json, compare tool) and FEAT-002 (dyn-prefixes.json, safelist evidence, snap-lb-before). Probe sizes: styles.css ~1,771 duplicate rules (~300 KB) and ~172 dead-by-token; aws-design.css ~96 dead; filters.css ~27; bottom-tab-bar.css 2. Be conservative: unsure means KEEP.
steps: Check no JS/test reads rules by index: git -P grep -n -E "cssRules|styleSheets|insertRule|deleteRule|adoptedStyleSheets" -- public tests routes lib server.js. If relevant hits exist keep duplicates in the involved files and report.

Write tmp-css-candidates.js (plan C.1-C.3): corpus = public/**/*.{html,js,json,webmanifest}, server.js, routes/**, lib/**, scripts/**, tests/**, plus cached Bootstrap/FontAwesome/Remixicon text; token USED by whole-word match, by dynamic PREFIX/SUFFIX/INFIX from dyn-prefixes.json, or by [class*=] style substrings; postcss-selector-parser for tokens (including inside :not/:is/:where/:has); KEEP unparseable/escaped selectors, rules declaring var()-referenced custom properties, @font-face, every @keyframes, :root/html/body, rules with attribute class selectors; duplicates = identical context chain + selector + declaration list in the same file with the EARLIER copy removed (cascade-safe proof in plan C.4); cross-check DEAD against coverage.json (covered => CONFLICT, KEEP, extend dyn list); REVIEW heuristics (comment-only usage, near-match tokens, recent git use). Emit candidates.json and candidates.md under $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1.

Read candidates.md in full, decide every REVIEW/CONFLICT item (default KEEP), write approved.json and kept-review.md. Write tmp-css-apply.js (postcss, preserves raws, original EOL per file) and tmp-css-rulecheck.js (after == before minus approved, empty at-rule blocks only).

Per file in this order: chat-reactions.css, app-theme.css, bottom-tab-bar.css, filters.css, each *-page.css, aws-design.css, styles.css. For each: apply, rulecheck (exit 0), snapshot + compare vs css-baseline (zero diffs), tmp-css-snapshot-lb.js vs snap-lb-before for files leaderboard loads (styles.css, bottom-tab-bar.css, app-theme.css, leaderboard-page.css), e2e canary, then commit that file alone: refactor(css): remove dead rules from <file>. On any diff: restore the file, bisect the approved list by halves, keep the offenders.

Write W/.agents/tasks/css-dead-rules-removed.txt (plan C.5.3: per file section with DEAD|DUP lines, selector, line, bytes, totals, bytes saved per file, KEPT and REPORTED-uncovered counts) and commit it: docs(css): record removed CSS rules. Save the final snapshot to $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\snap-C-final for FEAT-004.
Confirm git -P diff --stat e939a28..HEAD -- public/styles.deduped.min.css is empty unless FEAT-002 regenerated it; confirm no *.html changed.
acceptance_criteria: Every removed rule is DEAD (every class/id token of every selector absent from the corpus incl. dynamic-prefix expansion) or an exact EARLIER duplicate in the same file and same context chain; the removed list is in css-dead-rules-removed.txt with file, line, selector, bytes
tmp-css-rulecheck.js exits 0 for every edited file (after == before minus approved)
Snapshot compare against css-baseline has ZERO diffs after every commit; leaderboard extra-state compare has zero diffs
styles.deduped.min.css untouched by this phase; @font-face, @keyframes, :root untouched; no hand-written source changed except by rule removal
Bytes saved per file recorded (git blob sizes before/after); uncovered-but-not-removed rules are reported in css-audit.md, not removed
Per-file commits so each is revertable; e2e canary green after each
verification: node .agents\tasks\tmp-css-rulecheck.js <file> HEAD <approved.json>  (exit 0, per file, before committing)
npm run test:e2e -- smoke wrapping no-horizontal-overflow a11y  (green)
git -P diff --stat e939a28..HEAD -- tests public/styles.deduped.min.css  (empty unless FEAT-002 regenerated)
findings:
FEAT-003 done on refactor/css-consolidate-1 (nothing pushed, no cr). 9 CSS commits + 1 docs commit after bdc0199: 33c0f7c bottom-tab-bar.css, 7ae5863 filters.css, 1cbbe3a activity-page.css, 0393ccf formularz-page.css, b57a75a leaderboard-page.css, d7ec9f9 recipients-page.css, 7ca3fcf aws-design.css, 095d644 styles.css, 7ef3839 docs(css): record removed CSS rules (css-dead-rules-removed.txt + short Phase C addendum in css-audit.md). chat-reactions.css, app-theme.css and the other *-page.css files had no candidates (untouched).

TOTALS: 1,993 rules removed (296 DEAD, 1,697 DUP), 335,678 bytes saved (git blob sizes LF, bdc0199 -> HEAD). Per file (rules DEAD/DUP, before -> after bytes): bottom-tab-bar.css 2 (2/0) 25,257 -> 24,876 (-381); filters.css 27 (27/0) 12,393 -> 9,131 (-3,262); activity-page.css 1 (1/0) 7,999 -> 7,692 (-307); formularz-page.css 2 (2/0) 13,411 -> 12,991 (-420); leaderboard-page.css 1 (1/0) 22,967 -> 22,773 (-194); recipients-page.css 3 (3/0) 28,784 -> 28,207 (-577); aws-design.css 103 (96/7) 110,013 -> 96,816 (-13,197); styles.css 1,854 (164/1,690) 419,537 -> 102,197 (-317,340).

HOW: tmp-css-candidates.js (corpus = 110 text files in public/server/routes/lib/scripts/tests + 5 cached CDN texts, 26,616 distinct words; dyn prefixes/suffixes/infixes re-scanned and identical to FEAT-002; postcss-selector-parser; tokens in :not/:is/:where/:has must additionally have a top-level positive class/id token; html/body/:root, class/id attribute selectors, nesting, nested rules, escapes kept; custom-property rule; coverage CONFLICT cross-check = 0 conflicts). DUP = identical context chain + selector + declaration list, EARLIER copy removed, last kept (html/body/:root excluded). tmp-css-apply.js uses postcss, preserves EOL (CRLF), and strips the trailing spaces that postcss would otherwise leave on the previous kept line; tmp-css-rulecheck.js proves after == before minus approved (ordered rule/at-rule/@font-face-decl signatures, emptied at-rule blocks only, pure line deletion, surviving later copy for every DUP) and exited 0 for every file. git diff --minimal on styles.css shows 0 insertions / 13,101 deletions.

VERIFICATION: (1) cssRules/styleSheets grep: only tests/helpers/overflow.js (reads html/body rules by selector, not by index; html/body rules are never touched), so duplicates were removed. (2) Every CSS commit: rulecheck exit 0, targeted snapshot of every page that loads the file vs css-baseline = 0 diffs (bottom-tab-bar: all 56 files; filters: recipients incl. own-presents/edit-sheet states; aws-design: activity+recipients; activity-/formularz-/recipients-page: their page; leaderboard-page and bottom-tab-bar also leaderboard 11 extra states vs snap-lb-before = 0 diffs), e2e canary (smoke wrapping no-horizontal-overflow a11y) = 39 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed on the commit state. (3) Final full 14-page snapshot snap-C-final vs css-baseline: 56 files, 0 diffs, exit 0; final leaderboard extra-state compare: 0 diffs (464,419 cells/viewport). (4) git -P diff --stat e939a28..HEAD -- tests public/styles.deduped.min.css is empty; the only .html change since e939a28 is the FEAT-002 leaderboard href.

styles.css PROOF CAVEAT: since FEAT-002 styles.css has no page consumer (leaderboard now loads the deduped file), so the normal snapshot compare is vacuous for it. Extra proof: tmp-css-snapshot-raw.js serves styles.css bytes in place of /styles.deduped.min.css (context.route; sanity: swapping in HEAD styles.css differs from baseline by 163 cells on recipients@375, proving the swap is effective). Raw-swap snapshot of HEAD styles.css (snap-raw-before) vs edited styles.css (snap-raw-after) on all 14 pages x 4 viewports: 56 files, 0 diffs. Removed rules of styles.css therefore also have no visible effect if it is ever used again. A rebuild (npm run build:css:check) now reports different drift numbers because the generator input shrank; the deduped file stays frozen.

LOCATIONS (C:\Users\matmamon\AppData\Local\Temp\css-consolidate-1): snap-C-final (FINAL snapshot for FEAT-004, = HEAD 7ef3839 CSS state; copy snap-C-final-keep), candidates.json/candidates.md, approved.json, snap-raw-before, snap-raw-after, cmp-C-final.txt, cmp-raw.txt, canary-*.txt, branchcheck-main.txt. Docs in W/.agents/tasks: css-dead-rules-removed.txt (tracked, 2,066 lines), css-audit.md (addendum). Untracked temp tools added: tmp-css-c-lib.js, -candidates.js, -approve.js, -apply.js, -rulecheck.js, -c-verify.js, -c-round.ps1, -c-branchcheck.js, -c-doc.js, -c-addendum.js, -c-feat.js, -dbg.js, tmp-css-snapshot-only.js, -snapshot-raw.js, tmp-css-mkonly.js, -mkraw.js (delete with the other tmp-css-*.js at the end).

KEPT / REPORTED FOR REVIEW: 0 CONFLICT. 87 rules carried REVIEW flags and were removed after checking by hand: near-match hits were only camelCase JS ids/variables (searchInput, searchContainer, notificationDropdown, clearSearch, filterButtons, ...) or unrelated words (stat-card vs step-card); "recent git" hits were inline CSS moved into *-page.css by f5b7abf/2b6666a, except fixed-header-bar whose empty div was removed from markup; menu-home-link only in docs/archive; none of the 85 dead tokens occurs in the main tree (git grep main = no hits; origin/main is an older tree with inline CSS only). Policy keeps untouched: @font-face, all @keyframes, :root/html/body rules, class/id attribute selectors, rules with any USED token (partial usage keeps the whole rule), the truncated .profile-picture-placeholder rule with its nested :root in styles.css. Orphan section comments of removed rules were left in place (rule removal only). REPORTED uncovered but kept: 1,015 rules / 150,183 B (aws-design 372, styles 439, recipients-page 34, bottom-tab-bar 34, filters 37, other files 99). Unreferenced @keyframes reported only: filters.css highlightPulse; aws-design.css pulse-notification, spinner-rotate, dropdown-slide-in, fade-out.

FLAKES (not caused by this phase): the canary hit unrelated timing failures on pages that do not load the edited files: home page.goto net::ERR_ABORTED (seen with aws-design and styles runs, home is not affected by either file), chat bubble line count / chatMessages width 0 at 320px, activity card-body transient 32px width. Each was green on immediate rerun (aws-design 39 passed on rerun; styles.css: 39 passed on run 4; HEAD control without the styles.css edit also 39 passed). Snapshot harness also timed out twice on home once (bottom-tab-bar run) and passed on retry. Snapshots are slow (~7 min for 14 pages) because the machine is loaded.
NOTES FOR FEAT-004/005: the nested :root defect and --ios-success facts from FEAT-001 still apply. .container overflow-x: hidden lives in the frozen deduped file and in styles.css, where the two identical blocks were collapsed by DUP removal to ONE block (verified: 1 match remains; the earlier copy was removed). sw.js untouched; ?v= bumps still needed for bottom-tab-bar.css (42), filters.css (7), activity/formularz/leaderboard/recipients -page.css (1), aws-design.css (recipients ?v=4); chat-reactions.css and app-theme.css bytes are unchanged by this phase.
